d: Fundamental data structures for managing order of processing.

p: Stacks are Last-In-First-Out (LIFO), used for parsing (parentheses, reverse polish notation) and DFS. Queues are First-In-First-Out (FIFO), used for scheduling and BFS.
Stack: Push to end, Pop from end (O(1)).
Queue: Push to end, Pop from front. In Python, use `collections.deque` for O(1) front pops.

def isValid(s):
  stack = []
  mapping = {')': '(', '}': '{', ']': '['}
  for char in s:
    if char in mapping:
      if stack and stack[-1] == mapping[char]:
        stack.pop()
      else: return False
    else:
      stack.append(char)
  return not stack

Stack (LIFO):      Queue (FIFO):
  | 3 | (Top)     (Back) [3][2][1] (Front)
  | 2 |              -> Push     -> Pop
  | 1 |
  -----
